title: DeltaX Connectome Sensory Transduction Contract
description: Formal contract and mathematical specification of physical observation to biological receptor transduction in the DeltaX Connectome entity.

guarantee.statement: Transduction produces exclusively biological sensory receptor excitations (Hz). It does not compute, encode, or leak optimal steering policies, goal coordinates, path solutions, or precomputed executive decisions.

hill_equation_specification.description: Sigmoidal receptor activation mapping normalized sensory stimulus intensity c in [0, 1] to fractional response.

channels.observation_semantics: Continuous Euclidean distance from rover body to the nearest forward barrier or wall.
channels.transduction_function: For dist < 2.5: proxStrength = (2.5 - dist) / 2.5; rate = 120.0 * hill(proxStrength, k=0.4, n=1.4) Hz.
channels.policy_cheat_audit: PASS: Scalar distance only; no vector orientation, direction recommendations, or waypoint cues.

channels.observation_semantics: Immediate physical mechanical resistance encountered when attempting to move into an occupied grid cell.
channels.transduction_function: When blocked: JO rate = 140.0 Hz, tactile T1 rate = 160.0 Hz (burst mechanosensory deflection).
channels.policy_cheat_audit: PASS: Binary mechanical contact; does not suggest turning direction or recovery policy.

channels.physical_units: photon flux / ambient illumination rate [10.0, 65.0 Hz]
channels.observation_semantics: Ambient light level reaching compound eyes based on corridor clearance vs looming shadow.
channels.transduction_function: Clear corridor: 65.0 Hz; looming obstacle: max(10.0, 65.0 - (2.0 - proxDist) * 25.0) Hz.
channels.policy_cheat_audit: PASS: Scalar ambient illumination; contains zero goal coordinates or navigational vectors.

channels.observation_semantics: Diffusive nutrient concentration sensed at mouthparts and tarsi.
channels.transduction_function: rate = 160.0 * hill(food_signal, k=0.3, n=1.5) Hz; labellar rate = 0.9 * rate.
channels.policy_cheat_audit: PASS: Local scalar chemical concentration; no directional gradient vectors or path hints.

channels.observation_semantics: Presence of thermal or chemical danger in current substrate microenvironment.
channels.transduction_function: When hazard active: thermosensory rate = 180.0 Hz; bitter GRN rate = 150.0 Hz.
channels.policy_cheat_audit: PASS: Local noxious stimulus; does not encode avoidance maneuvers or executive vetoes.
